body:
It is very important to note that imagery is a strong part of Calea and it is more of a tool for depression rather than a tool for lucid dreaming. What I mean by that is that it opens my eyes a little wider and allows me to dream an honest dream. Maybe even conquer a fear of a dream.
I dipped my cigarette into the bag of 10.1x Dream herb, and began my journey.  A color enhancer was definatly there
A color enhancer was definatly there
as well as an open minded view of nature.
